scope: Learning-capability baseline only; ordinary trained tanh MLP, not architectural novelty or RFF. Old 2020-2021 development, no untouched test claim.
model: 60 inputs -> 24 trainable tanh hidden units -> 3 jointly trainable outputs; all biases learned; scipy L-BFGS-B analytic backprop
input: 60 reverse chronological one-step increments divided by current causal 60-increment RMS; predicted normalized changes multiplied by that RMS; horizon loss scales fitted only on initial pre-2020 prices
labels: 1,5,20 observation-step changes; exclusive fit_end; training origin+20 < fit_end; last at most480 mature origins; refit every40 points
synthetic: Independent 480 train and 2000 held-out rows per fixed seed, 60 Gaussian inputs, unit local scales; positive target (1,2,3)*tanh(2*x0) plus Gaussian noise sd .1; null independent Gaussian outputs. Synthetic fixture is a capability diagnostic not a market process, extra sample availability is explicit.
gate: Both positive-control seeds must achieve held-out MSE/RW <0.6 and MSE/ridge <0.9, objective decrease, finite parameters and gradient finite-difference relative error <1e-5; otherwise no market access. Null reported, not used for tuning.
market: Read exactly header plus950 permitted records bytewise, never request2022 boundary;451 common same-year origins; RAW MLP only one architecture/regularization/window; both seeds retained, equal mean loss not best seed and not prediction ensemble
baselines: RW fresh; MLE window480 and simple trend residual correction alpha1 fixed from earlier development, recompute and label historically selected scores; no new tuning
metric: Original price squared error; relative RW MSE per year/horizon then equal mean over six cells
retention: Protocol hash, source review, environment, gradients, controls, every-fit objectives/solver status/maturity, all seeds predictions and parameters local NPZ, independent saved-score and future perturbation verification. No commit/push.
